description: This file defines the LDAPSyncStatus entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing the status of LDAP synchronization including timestamps and status codes, with ORM mappings for database persistence.

classes.name: LDAPSyncStatus
classes.description: Entity class representing LDAP synchronization status with properties for sync timestamps, user, and status, including ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the LDAP sync status record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the LDAP sync status record.

methods.name: getSyncStartedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when LDAP sync started.

methods.name: setSyncStartedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when LDAP sync started.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when LDAP sync finished.

methods.name: setSyncFinishedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when LDAP sync finished.

methods.name: getSyncedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the sync.

methods.name: setSyncedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who performed the synchronization.

methods.name: getSyncStatus
methods.description: Returns the current synchronization status code.
